mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, s.seat_id AS seatId, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_colume AS seatColume, s.grade, r.reserved_status AS status, pp.price FROM RESERVATIONS r JOIN SEATS s ON r.seat_id = s.seat_id JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND pr ON r.round_id = pr.round_id JOIN PERFORMANCE_PRICE pp ON pp.performance_id = pr.performance_id AND pp.grade = s.grade WHERE r.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY s.seat_row, s.seat_colume
SELECT pp.price FROM PERFORMANCE_ROUND pr JOIN PERFORMANCE_PRICE pp ON pp.performance_id = pr.performance_id WHERE pr.round_id = #{roundId} AND pp.grade = #{grade}
SELECT seat_id AS seatId, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_colume AS seatColume, grade FROM SEATS WHERE seat_id = #{seatId}
